page.layout: One printed page, two columns of names under the centred heading "AUTORUM."; the left column runs first, then the right. Letter markers (N., O., P., R., S.) stand within the columns. Edge fragments of the neighbouring page at the left and bottom-left are not transcribed.
page.notes: No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed. The large initials O (Occam), P (Pacius), R (Amus) and S (Abellicus) are joined to their words. "Mendoza" is set with a mark over the final vowel, read as uncertain. The Greek-style "PtolemæusPhiladelph:" has no space in print; copied as printed. The tweezers, the dark background and the fragments of the neighbouring page are not transcribed.
